stage0094_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Things have gone smoothly so far.」

stage0094_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「If we maintain this pace,
　we'll reach a position overlooking Leyte Island in three hours.」

stage0094_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But Neo Zeon won't just
　leave us be.」

stage0094_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「I expect the $c ships departing $$メリダ島$$ later
　will serve as a diversion, but...」

stage0094_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「You think they'll move, using this as a chance?」

stage0094_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「There have already been several instances of them
　cooperating with Neo Zeon, or rather,
　with $$フル・フロンタル$$'s faction.」

stage0094_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$テッサ$$
「What's more, they've also been seen
　coordinating with Geminis.」

stage0094_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Neo Zeon's $$フル・フロンタル$$, Amalgam,
　Geminis...」

stage0094_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「I see...
　Every one of them holds a particular
　hostility toward $c and $$ミスリル$$.」

stage0094_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I can't imagine they'd let this chance slip by.」

stage0094_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Zeon underwater mobile suits confirmed on our heading!」

stage0094_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「So, they've come after all...」

stage0094_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It seems our movements were detected.」

stage0094_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「What are your orders, Captain?」

stage0094_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$テッサ$$
「We can't afford to waste time or strength here.
　We'll force a breakthrough with this ship.」

stage0094_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye aye, ma'am!
　All hands, battle stations!」

stage0094_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Sagara, everyone...
　I'll get you all to space, whatever it takes.）

stage0094_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Enemy craft closing in confirmed!
　They're charging straight at us!」

stage0094_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「The ballast tanks are damaged!
　We're having trouble adjusting buoyancy!」

stage0094_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It can't be helped.
　The Danaan will surface close to sea level!
　We'll deploy the strike force there!」

stage0094_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye, ma'am!
　The Danaan, surface!」

stage0094_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$宗介$$
「We'll cover the Danaan from this position!」

stage0094_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant, enemy units are inbound to this area.」

stage0094_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Nice work, Mr. Zeon.
　You drew them out nicely.」

stage0094_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ガウルン$$!
　So you're alive!?」

stage0094_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Yo, Kashim.
　That turnaround in Hong Kong was quite the show.」

stage0094_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Guess a trick like that wasn't gonna kill you after all.
　So here I am, come in person.」

stage0094_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「The enemy's an Amalgam elite unit...!」

stage0094_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$クルツ$$
「On top of Lambda Driver models,
　there's that huge AS too...!」

stage0094_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$マオ$$
「Working with Neo Zeon
　to crush us, huh...!」

stage0094_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「And on top of that, $$ファイヤバグ$$ and that unpleasant
　trio of theirs are here too.」

stage0094_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$宗介$$
「As always, $$キリコ$$ just ignores it.」

stage0094_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Ignore the eyesore punks...
　I should take a page from his book.」

stage0094_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ベック$$
「That stuck-up attitude of his
　is what I hate!」

stage0094_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I know how you feel, $$ベック$$!
　That's why today we must make them eat their words!」

stage0094_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
（Ever since the $$姫$$ cast us aside, it's been
　one hardship after another, but taking in
　that trio made it even worse...）

stage0094_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
（Those guys... are they cursed!?）

stage0094_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
（Ahh... where is our new $$姫$$...）

stage0094_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Work hard, Mister $$ゲイツ$$.
　Don't waste the favor I did you, giving work
　to a guy who quit the organization.」

stage0094_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Oh, listen to you!
　You let your pet Lolita run wild in Hong Kong,
　so why do you get off scot-free!」

stage0094_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Mr. Ag took care of that nicely for me.」

stage0094_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Ugh, I hate it, I hate it!
　In the end, it's all about who you know!
　What a harsh world, so hard to live in!」

stage0094_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「So, want to come back to Amalgam?」

stage0094_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Don't make me laugh.
　This $$ゲイツ$$... is satisfied with his life now.」

stage0094_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「The most important thing in this world!
　It's freedom! A free heart bound by nothing!
　Viva freedom!」

stage0094_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$宗介$$
「But be careful.
　His skill is real.」

stage0094_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Well then, here I come, Kashim.
　And you too, $c.」

stage0094_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This is my one true final battle!」

stage0094_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$宗介$$
「Just what I wanted, $$ガウルン$$!
　This time, I'll settle things with you for good!」

stage0094_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「But this means our arrival at Leyte Island
　will be significantly delayed.」

stage0094_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That's likely exactly what Amalgam
　and Neo Zeon were aiming for.」

stage0094_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「An intruder on our comm line!?」

stage0094_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「It looks like $c's units are getting the transmission too.」

stage0094_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$レナード$$
「I'd rather you not be surprised by something this small.
　You $$ミスリル$$ folks seem to have a habit
　of thinking you're the top of the world.」

stage0094_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$レナード$$
「That's right.
　I've been given the code name Mr. Ag.」

stage0094_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$レナード$$
「First, let me honestly commend you
　for turning back the unit we sent.」

stage0094_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$レナード$$
「But meanwhile, we took the opportunity
　to crush your lifeline.」

stage0094_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$レナード$$
「Amalgam's forces destroyed
　the launch facility on Leyte Island.
　This should delay $c's trip to space considerably.」

stage0094_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Are you saying you don't care what happens to the world?」

stage0094_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$レナード$$
「I don't think that at all.
　But $$エタニティ・フラット$$ and Neo Zeon
　are both trivial matters to me.」

stage0094_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$レナード$$
「Why don't you give up already?
　Risking your life to protect such a twisted world
　is a ridiculous thing to do.」

stage0094_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$レナード$$
「Or do you still not understand, Teletha?」

stage0094_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$レナード$$
「Then let me make you understand.
　It's not a very smart method, though.」

stage0094_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$レナード$$
「Facing this many at once
　will be tough, even for your prized submarine.」

stage0094_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$レナード$$
「You'd do well to surrender quietly, Teletha.」

stage0094_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...$$マデューカス$$, $$カリーニン$$,
　please recover $c's units.」

stage0094_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「All units, return to the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」

stage0094_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What are you planning to do, $$テッサ$$!?」

stage0094_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「For now, we have no choice but to follow Captain Testarossa's orders.」

stage0094_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Recovery of all units confirmed.」

stage0094_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$レナード$$
「Planning to force your way through?
　But I've already read that tactic.」

stage0094_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード$$...
　Neither we nor the world will go the way you want.」

stage0094_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Attention all hands!
　From here, we set sail into an uncharted sea!」

stage0094_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$かなめ$$, here we go!」

stage0094_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, surface!!」

stage0094_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「All systems stable!
　Kaname Chidori's vitals are fine too!」

stage0094_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Thrust to maximum!
　All systems, switch to Mode S!」

stage0094_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye aye, ma'am!
　Switching to Mode S!」

stage0094_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$テッサ$$
「This ship will now break atmosphere!」

stage0094_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Let's go, $$宗介$$... everyone...
　to protect this world...）

stage0094_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Not bad, Kashim.
　You've gone soft, but you seem to have gotten stronger too...」

stage0094_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「If you think that's something to say, you're dead wrong!
　Kashim! Let's fall to hell together!」

stage0094_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't be so cold, Kashim!」

stage0094_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$宗介$$
「Kashim, Kashim, so familiar all of a sudden,
　you bastard!!」

stage0094_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Hahahaha!
　Thanks. It was the best life a guy could ask for!」

stage0094_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「So that was that man's end...」

stage0094_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$宗介$$
「...To me, he was just another enemy.
　I feel no needless sentiment.」

stage0094_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If that's what you say, then that's fine.」

stage0094_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$宗介$$
（$$ガウルン$$...
　I won't become what you wanted.）

stage0094_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$宗介$$
（I'm not Kashim anymore.
　I'm Jindai High Year 2 Class 4's trash duty, a Volunteer Club member,
　$$ミスリル$$'s $$ウルズ$$ 7, $c's $$相良宗介$$.）

stage0094_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Ha-haah!
　Not bad at all, gentlemen!
　But that's all for today!」

stage0094_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Sea breeze is the enemy of my sideburns!
　So, with that said, I'll be taking my leave!」

stage0094_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Argh!
　Is this as far as I can go!?」

stage0094_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you'll regret this, $$キリコ$$!
　You'll regret this! You'll regret this!」

stage0094_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$カレン$$
「What was that about?
　Did he finally run out of parting shots?」

stage0094_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「He got a reaction out of $$キリコ$$ for once.
　Maybe that rattled him.」

stage0094_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ベック$$
「Tch!
　This is exactly why I said
　I hated taking jobs like this!」

stage0094_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's unseemly, $$ベック$$.
　A professional must see a job through
　to the end, once he's accepted it.」

stage0094_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ベック$$
「Shut up!
　My biggest complaint about this job
　is having to look at your face, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!」

stage0094_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ベック$$
「One of these days, I'll show you!
　My true power, that is!」

stage0094_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ベック$$
「Don't you dare die before then,
　you damn negotiator!!」

stage0094_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Still, who'd have thought a punk like that
　would wish me luck.」

stage0094_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Actually, surprisingly, it doesn't.
　He's a petty little crook, but like me,
　he's someone who's escaped the curse of Memory.」

stage0094_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「I've shot down every $$アクシオ・バーグラー$$ unit.」

stage0094_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Still, sounds like they're having a hard time too.」

stage0094_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$カトル$$
「I suppose that's what happens
　when you lose a strong leader.」

stage0094_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$カレン$$
「What'll you do, $$テッサ$$?
　Those guys might come to recruit you again.」

stage0094_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Still, they're first-class
　when it comes to stubbornness.」

stage0094_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$青山$$
「At this rate, they'll be running wild
　for a while yet.」

stage0094_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Guess we'll leave delivering
　the final blow to him, after all.」

stage0094_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Well... knowing him,
　he'll probably say there's nothing in it for him.」

stage0094_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「I've shot down every $$アクシオ・バーグラー$$ unit.」

stage0094_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Still, sounds like they're having a hard time too.」

stage0094_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$デュオ$$
「No kidding.
　Well, they're first-class when it comes to stubbornness.」

stage0094_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$青山$$
「At this rate, they'll be running wild
　for a while yet.」

stage0094_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Guess we'll leave delivering
　the final blow to him, after all.」

stage0094_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Well... knowing him,
　he'll probably say there's nothing in it for him.」

stage0094_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I understand.
　The enemy's aim is probably to hold us back here.」

stage0094_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That's why we need to break through
　these waters as quickly as we can.」

stage0094_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye, ma'am.
　This crew will give it everything we have.」

stage0094_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$テッサ$$
（But we need to prepare
　for the worst, just in case...）

stage0094_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「A last battle with you
　on some tiny island nobody's heard of!
　This is the best, Kashim!」

stage0094_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$宗介$$
「Get out of the way, $$ガウルン$$!
　We have to go!」

stage0094_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I know!
　That's exactly why we came, to hold you back!」

stage0094_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Ha, that's rich!
　Me, a guy with a bit of a name in the underworld,
　and my end is being a throwaway pawn!」

stage0094_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Whoa, don't get the wrong idea, Kashim!
　I don't care how big the fight is
　or how important the mission is!」

stage0094_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「All that matters is how much fun I have!
　That's the only thing that counts!」

stage0094_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$宗介$$
「So what!
　I'm always me!
　I won't be fooled by the likes of you anymore!」

stage0094_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That's it, that's it, Kashim!
　Your direction's changed a bit, but the Kashim
　I love has come back!」

stage0094_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Guess this means we can take a piss
　together in hell, no regrets!」

stage0094_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Shut up, $$ガウルン$$!
　Go there by yourself!」

stage0094_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$宗介$$
「I said shut up, $$ガウルン$$!!」

stage0094_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Found you, whitey!
　Ever since I ran into you,
　my life's been nothing but bad luck!」

stage0094_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$宗介$$
「I don't care about your life!」

stage0094_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Ha ha ha!
　That was a lie, whitey!
　Deep down, I'm actually grateful to you!」

stage0094_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Getting beaten by you is what made me
　quit Amalgam, and once I did,
　my world opened up without limits!」

stage0094_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant... I do not understand
　what he is saying.」

stage0094_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$宗介$$
「Don't worry, $$アル$$.
　I don't either.」

stage0094_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$宗介$$
「There's only one thing we need to do...!
　Eliminate the enemy, swiftly!」

stage0094_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Ah, wait a second!
　I was just about to show you
　this new sensation I've discovered!」

stage0094_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$宗介$$
「I have no interest in a world that twisted!」

stage0094_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ベック$$
「Wait a second!
　You're supposed to be a negotiator,
　and you go straight for force!?」

stage0094_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「We're in a hurry.
　Talking with someone too dim to understand
　my words would be a waste of time.」

stage0094_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Or, $$ベック$$...
　do you actually intend to hear me out?」

stage0094_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then our interests align!
　In that case, I'll proceed without hesitation!」

stage0094_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ベック$$
「S-something about this doesn't sit right, hey!」

stage0094_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$!
　Today's the day I finally settle things with you!」

stage0094_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Those words... how many times now?」
